---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something you wish Duplicate Finder could do
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What do you wish you could do?**
<!-- One or two plain sentences. Example: "Ignore files bigger than 1 GB when scanning."
Also fine here: a behaviour you would rather it had - a default, a warning before trashing, a label
on a button, a message you would rather read. -->

**Why do you need it / how would you use it?**
<!-- The real-world task behind it. This tells us which of several designs fits how you actually work. -->

**What do you do today instead?**
<!-- Which other tool or extra steps you use now, and what is wrong with that. -->

**How often does it bite you?**
<!-- every scan / weekly / now and then / once, but it cost me time. Frequency decides what we build first. -->

**Would you test it?**
<!-- happy to try a test build / would try a packaged version / no time to test - all three are fine answers. -->

**Anything else**
<!-- A screenshot of the screen you mean, examples of the files involved, or the folder layout you work
with (a tree of folder names is plenty). If it is machine-specific, run ./scripts/bugreport.sh and paste it. -->
